title: Wolf & Sofsky GmbH
description: Wolf & Sofsky GmbH is a construction company with a 75-year history, based in Zweibrücken, Germany. The company operates on highly complex projects and maintains a significant financial position.  Critical Information We Possess Financial Data: Complete spectrum of financial information (reports, budgets, cost estimates), revealing project profitability, total revenue, cost structure, and financial stability of the company.  Commercial Information: Contracts with clients, commercial offers, contract terms — these form the foundation of Wolf & Sofsky's competitive advantage.  Personal Data: Information about employees and clients (names, contacts, job titles, possibly salaries), which falls under GDPR legislation.  Technical Assets: Technical plans, project drawings, architectural solutions — the company's unique intellectual property.  Strategic Plans: Business plans and strategic documents, revealing development directions, new markets, and future projects.
